# Authors directory — sources and photograph licences

*Generated by `node scripts/authors/report.mjs` from `src/content/authors/*.json` and `data/authors/verification.json`. Do not edit by hand.*

## What is on the page

28 researched authors: 13 historical voices, 5 makers of games and puzzles, 10 novelists of sapphic and lesbian romance. 8 of them are also on the Valice list (an edition of their public-domain work is published here); the other 20 are **reference authors**, shown for the reading context around the shelf, and every page says in plain words that Valice Press has no connection with them.

Three authors Valice publishes who are not researched here — Emre Doğan, Harper Hayes and Quinn Gallagher — have pages built only from the catalogue's approved biographies and their books; nothing about them is taken from outside.

## How each fact was checked

`scripts/authors/verify-sources.mjs` fetches every listed source and fails unless: the source answers 200 and names the person; the **birth and death years agree across Wikidata and the Library of Congress authority record** (two independent compilations); every year in the works and timeline appears in the sources' text; and each key claim (an award, an epithet, a title) appears there word for word. Last full run: **2026-10-08**, 28/28 authors passing.

Where two sources disagree it is written down on the person's page (A note on the dates) and in the data: **H. J. R. Murray** — The Library of Congress authority record gives the birth year as 1869; Wikipedia and Wikidata give 24 June 1868, as does The Oxford Companion to Chess (Hooper & Whyld, 2nd ed., pp. 265–66), which Wikipedia cites. 1868 is used here. **Henry Lee** — Wikipedia gives his birth as 1826 or 1827; the Dictionary of National Biography entry, which it follows, is titled "Lee, Henry (1826–1888)". 1826 is used here, marked as approximate.

## Photographs

22 of 28 have a photograph (or, for ancient and some Victorian subjects, a painting or a bust); the rest show an initials mark and say so. Every file is from Wikimedia Commons, passed a licence allowlist (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA — nothing NonCommercial, nothing with a Commons restriction flag), was decoded and re-encoded by us at 3:4 and never enlarged, and carries its credit line, licence, source URL, the source file's SHA-1 and the published file's SHA-256 in its JSON.

Licences: Public domain × 12, CC BY-SA 4.0 × 3, CC BY-SA 3.0 × 2, CC BY 2.0 × 2, CC0 × 2, CC BY-SA 2.0 × 1.

Refused: Malinda Lo's only free photograph (Commons flags personality rights). No free photograph found for Henry Lee, Katherine V. Forrest, Radclyffe, Thomas Keightley, Wirt Sikes.
